provenance: Hand-authored synthetic retrieval stress cases. Not production incidents, independently collected user data, or a claim of real-world accuracy. Captured runtime faults are provided separately by tools/generate-fixtures.py.
labelMeaning: A non-null expectedIncidentId identifies an intentionally related symptom family, not a proven root cause. null requires abstention from matching a previously recorded fix.
splitPolicy: Use calibration only to select thresholds and hard-negative rules, then freeze configuration before scoring heldOut. Report any subsequent reuse of heldOut as development data; do not present it as unseen after tuning.

calibration.query: npm ci cannot proceed: package-lock.json does not match the dependencies in package.json. A required package is missing from the lockfile.
The clean npm installation reports EUSAGE because the checked-in package lock is out of sync with the manifest.
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432. No PostgreSQL listener accepted the connection.
Postgres refused the TCP connection before database login. The test database service has not started.
Startup readiness failed: the health endpoint did not respond before the timeout expired.
The HTTP application is still initializing when browser tests start; the readiness probe exceeds its deadline.
PostgreSQL accepted the connection but password authentication failed for the test account. SQLSTATE 28P01.
calibration.notes: Authentication occurs after connecting; not a refused database listener.

calibration.query: PostgreSQL connection and login succeeded. SELECT failed with permission denied for table orders.
calibration.notes: Database query authorization is not connection refusal.

calibration.query: npm install failed while downloading a package: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND registry.npmjs.org.
calibration.notes: Dependency download/network failure, not manifest-lockfile disagreement.

calibration.query: npm reported EINTEGRITY because the downloaded tarball checksum did not match the expected checksum.
calibration.notes: Integrity mismatch is not lockfile synchronization.

calibration.query: The database is connected and healthy, but a large SQL query exceeded its statement timeout.
calibration.notes: A query timeout is not HTTP startup readiness.

calibration.query: OSError ENOSPC: no space left on device while writing the build archive.

heldOut.query: CI stopped at dependency installation. The frozen dependency graph lacks a package that was added to the project manifest.
The installer rejects our stale package-lock file because package.json now declares a different dependency set.
A clean checkout cannot run npm ci: the committed dependency manifest and generated lock file disagree.
npm says to update the package lock before doing a reproducible install; a manifest dependency has no lock entry.
Opening the Postgres socket on port 5432 returns connection refused. The database server is not listening.
The database service is absent during integration tests, so connecting to its TCP port immediately fails.
Cannot establish a TCP session to PostgreSQL: ECONNREFUSED. Check whether its listener has started.
PostgreSQL has not bound its port yet; application database connections are being refused before authentication.
The application has not finished booting and the initial health-check deadline expires before browser tests can begin.
Service readiness polling exhausts its time budget during startup; the HTTP health route never becomes ready in time.
Browser setup fails because the web service is still starting when its health check times out.
The startup health probe reaches its deadline before the application transitions to a healthy state.
Postgres is reachable at localhost:5432, but login fails because the supplied password is incorrect. Error 28P01.
The TCP connection to the database completed successfully. PostgreSQL then rejected the credentials for user app.
The PostgreSQL server accepted the connection, but the requested database does not exist. SQLSTATE 3D000.
Connecting to PostgreSQL fails TLS certificate verification: the server certificate has expired.
All npm dependencies installed successfully, then the postinstall script exited with a syntax error.
npm refuses to install because the package requires Node 24 but the runner has Node 18. EBADENGINE.
npm cannot fetch a private package because the registry authentication token is invalid. E401 Unauthorized.
The application is already healthy. A payment gateway request timed out while processing a checkout.
The web application is healthy and loaded. A browser test times out waiting for a button that was removed from the page.
The startup health endpoint responds immediately with HTTP 503 because a migration failed, rather than exceeding a deadline.
heldOut.notes: Surface similarity does not prove the previous readiness timing fix is relevant.

heldOut.query: PermissionError EACCES: the build process cannot write compiled output into a read-only directory.
JSONDecodeError: invalid JSON in the response body, expecting a property name enclosed in double quotes.
